faq.q: Why does my Chinese building look like a generic temple?
faq.a: You forgot "red walls" + "gold tiles" + "flying eaves". These three = Forbidden City specifically.
Add "tourist small figure in foreground". Tiny person + giant building = immediate scale.
16:9 with clear sky + named building + tiny figure. Reads as "travel China" instantly.
